name: risk_appetite
description: Risk appetite and regulatory limits, each hard or soft.

rows.name: single_name
rows.label: Single obligor
rows.basis: CP-1.1: SAR 250m per obligor, funded and unfunded EAD

rows.name: group_connected
rows.label: Connected group
rows.basis: CP-1.2: SAR 500m per connected group (ownership or control, relationship domain rel-saudi-v1)

rows.name: group_large_exposure
rows.label: Group large exposure
rows.basis: SAMA large exposures: 25% of Tier 1

rows.name: sector_policy
rows.label: Sector (policy)
rows.basis: CP-1.3: 18% of the corporate book

rows.name: sector_appetite
rows.label: Sector (appetite)
rows.basis: Risk appetite statement 2026

rows.name: rating_bucket
rows.label: Rating bucket
rows.basis: Risk appetite statement 2026

rows.name: collateral_type
rows.label: Collateral concentration
rows.basis: Share of book EAD secured by real estate

rows.name: min_rating
rows.label: Minimum rating
rows.basis: Credit policy: no new money below B-; existing clients to CCC by escalation

rows.name: max_tenor
rows.label: Maximum tenor
rows.basis: Tenor matrix by rating bucket

rows.name: ltv
rows.label: Loan to value
rows.basis: Real-estate finance: maximum LTV 70%

rows.name: dscr
rows.label: DSCR after the deal
rows.basis: CP-2.1: DSCR at least 1.20x

rows.name: debt_ebitda
rows.label: Debt/EBITDA after the deal
rows.basis: CP-2.1: leverage at most 4.0x

rows.name: balloon
rows.label: Balloon share
rows.basis: Credit policy: balloon at most 50%

rows.name: bu_rwa_budget
rows.label: BU RWA budget
rows.basis: Corporate Banking new-business RWA budget, Q4 2026

rows.name: bu_el_budget
rows.label: BU EL budget
rows.basis: Corporate Banking new-business EL budget, Q4 2026 (year-1 EL)

rows.name: top20_obligor_share
rows.label: Top-20 obligor concentration
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 4.1: the 20 largest obligors' EAD at most 2.0% of the corporate book

rows.name: sector_hhi
rows.label: Sector concentration (HHI)
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 4.2: Herfindahl index of sector shares of the corporate book at most 0.09

rows.name: sub_ig_share
rows.label: Sub-investment-grade share
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 3.1: EAD rated BB+ or worse at most 62% of the corporate book

rows.name: unsecured_share
rows.label: Unsecured share
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 3.2: EAD with no tangible collateral, cash margin or eligible guarantee (a corporate guarantee alone counts as unsecured) at most 22%

rows.name: re_construction_share
rows.label: Real estate and construction
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 2.3 (Board limit): real estate and construction together at most 22.85% of the corporate book

rows.name: long_tenor_share
rows.label: Long tenor (over 7 years)
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 5.1: new business with tenor over 7 years at most 35% of new-business EAD (the book carries no maturity, so this is measured on new business)

rows.name: stage2_share
rows.label: Stage 2 share of book
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 3.3: Stage 2 EAD at most 30% of the corporate book after new business (a deal counts by its Stage 2 probability next quarter when the forward-risk model is available, else by the obligor's current stage)

rows.name: cost_of_risk_bps
rows.label: Expected cost of risk
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 6.1: 12-month expected loss on the performing book at most 55 bps of EAD (budget 2026)

rows.name: raroc_floor
rows.label: New-business RAROC floor
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 6.2: lifetime RAROC of the approved new business (PV risk-adjusted profit / PV capital) at least 12%

rows.name: region_share
rows.label: Region concentration
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 4.3: any one region at most 30% of the corporate book

rows.name: connected_lending_share
rows.label: Related-party and connected lending
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 4.4: EAD to obligors in connected groups of two or more companies (relationship domain rel-saudi-v1) at most 70% of the corporate book

rows.name: islamic_share
rows.label: Islamic share of new business
rows.basis: Risk Appetite Statement 2026, item 7.1: Shariah-compliant structures at least 40% of new-business EAD (the book carries no structure flag, so this is measured on new business)

optimiser.basis: Pipeline optimiser: a soft limit taken past its trigger costs 2% of the EAD beyond the trigger (the capital add-on the CFO charges for an appetite excess), as SAR m of SVA; an option is approvable in the pipeline only if it clears the hurdle by at least SAR 5k of SVA (below that it adds no value and only consumes budget)

levels: R11: each limit carries appetite (green), trigger (amber) and limit (red) levels; status is green up to the trigger (above appetite is flagged), amber from the trigger to the limit, red beyond the limit.
